patch_name: PINN preservation exploratory validation - frozen v2
basis: current Stage11 source package supplied by user
platform_rule: All candidates in one full run must execute on the same machine and software environment; runtime is recorded only for audit, not compared as evidence.

candidates.v1_physics_first: physics-dominated conservative initialization with weak robust observation anchor; fixed forcing identification; current projected-gradient refinement
candidates.v2_physics_first_anchor: V1 plus a fixed anchor to the physics-first background during refinement
candidates.v3_dct_init: frozen selected DCT-II screened-Poisson background -> MLP distillation -> fixed forcing identification -> current projected-gradient refinement
candidates.v4_budgeted_conflict: current data-first initialization and forcing fit; Stage3 allows bounded anti-data physics gradients instead of full conflict projection

hypothesis: A conservative initial decomposition may better preserve uncertain astronomical low-frequency structure because under-separation can be corrected later, whereas structure absorbed into the background early is difficult to identify and recover without truth labels.
